It loads only the Rails controller stack;\\n  Active Record and Rails migrations are deliberately not used.\\n- `Gemfile` and `Gemfile.lock` pin the Rails/Rack/Puma runtime.\\n\\n## Request routing and state\\n\\n`DndApi.routes` at the end of `app.rb` is the authoritative route list.\\nControllers inherit from `ApplicationController`, which parses request JSON,\\nnormalizes integer inputs, and renders the common invalid-request response.\\n\\n`GameStorage` owns the SQLite connection, schema setup, reset operation, and a\\nprocess-local mutex.  Its database file is `game.db` beside `app.rb` and\\npersists users, combat sessions, compendium records, and campaign records\\nacross server restarts.  `GameStorage.initialize_schema!` runs during boot.\\nAll storage reads and writes are made inside `GameStorage.synchronize` so the\\nsingle shared SQLite connection is used safely by Puma threads.  Storage reset\\nis intentionally exposed through `POST /v1/storage/reset` and is the only API\\noperation that clears persisted state.\\n\\n## API/domain groupings\\n\\n- Core rules: health, dice statistics, ability checks, initiative ordering,\\n  characters, and adjusted encounter XP.\\n- Combat and auth: persistent combat sessions/conditions/turn advancement and\\n  SQLite-backed user registration/login.  `CombatSessionState` and\\n  `AuthCredentials` hold their non-routing mechanics.\\n- Compendium and campaigns: monster/item records, campaign characters/events,\\n  persistent scheduled sessions/attendance, campaign state, and deterministic\\n  analytics summaries/risk reports.\\n- PHB utilities: spell slots, long-rest recovery, and equipment load.\\n- DM tools: encounter building from campaign/compendium data, deterministic\\n  tier-one loot, and the latest campaign-event recap.  `EncounterMath` is\\n  shared by the core and DM encounter endpoints to keep their XP behavior in\\n  lockstep.\\n\\n## Safe extension and testing conventions\\n\\nPreserve the existing route, status-code, response-shape, validation, and\\npersistence contracts: the benchmark is cumulative.  Put controller-only\\nrequest handling in the relevant controller and extract only genuinely shared,\\nside-effect-free logic into a focused module.  Keep database access inside the\\nstorage mutex and use parameterized SQL.  Add schema changes to\\n`GameStorage.initialize_schema!` and ensure `reset!` drops any new tables.\\n\\nPrefer deterministic ordering and values; existing APIs intentionally sort\\ninitiative and query campaign collections by insertion order.
